n: <int> Number of items available to be packed into knapsacks.
capacity: <int> Maximum total weight each knapsack can hold.
weights: <list[int], length n> Weight of each item, sorted in non-decreasing order.
values: <list[int], length n> Individual value earned when each item is packed into any knapsack.
pairwise_values: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Symmetric matrix of bonus values earned when two items are placed in the same knapsack.
